purpose: Small first-stage candidate set for Windows guest differential testing. Every other kernel entry point remains the untouched host implementation.
requirements: Build against the same ntoskrnl.exe/PDB build as the host.
Run the Windows guest smoke suite before adding another function.
Do not treat compilation or the Linux silicon harness as a Windows behavior proof.

functions.name: KeGetCurrentIrql
functions.reason: Raw CPU/IRQL read; candidate is kept only as a first-stage guest smoke target.

functions.name: PsGetProcessId
functions.reason: Leaf field accessor with no allocation, blocking, or global mutation.

functions.name: PsGetThreadId
functions.reason: Leaf field accessor with no allocation, blocking, or global mutation.

functions.name: MmSizeOfMdl
functions.reason: Pure MDL page-span arithmetic; no external side effects.

functions.name: RtlTestBit
functions.reason: Leaf bitmap read; no allocation, blocking, or global mutation.

functions.name: RtlSetBit
functions.reason: Leaf bitmap write; guest differential testing must cover alignment and races.
